price_basis: Tequila pour prices = rounded median single-pour price for that brand across current menus in the PHG corpus (public.menu_item_brands, section_type=spirits, $5–40). Expression-agnostic, so a blanco may be over-priced vs the brand median. Mezcal prices are placeholders.
iowa_basis: iowa_accounts = public.v_brand_geography_presence distinct accounts in IA
region_note: region filled only where the design lead is confident; verify before print
ingredient_order: base spirit → modifier/liqueur → sweetener → citrus → bitters → soda/lengthener → other; garnish separate
